test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In November 2021, an overall cost of Rs. ______ was approved for the continuation of the umbrella scheme 'Ocean Services, Modelling, Application, Resources and Technology (O-SMART)' for the period 2021-26.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 2,177 crores**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ocean - Services, Modelling, Application, Resources, and Technology (O-SMART)

 
 
• The Cabinet Committee approved the umbrella programme **Ocean - Services, Modelling, Application, Resources, and Technology (O-SMART) **on **August 29, 2018**, for implementation in 2017–18 and 2019–20 at a total cost of Rs. 1.623 crores.
 
• The Ministry of Earth Sciences' umbrella programme **O-SMART** has received approval for its continuation from** the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs**, which is chaired by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi and will continue to be implemented from 2021 to 2026 at a cost of Rs. 2177 crore.
 
• The primary objective of the O-SMART scheme is to **offer services and projections based on ongoing oceanic research **and it also encourages leading **ocean sciences research**.
 
• **Seven sub-schemes that make up the overall O-SMART scheme: **
 
 
• Ocean Technology
 
• Coastal Research
 
• Ocean Observation Network (OON)
 
• Ocean Modelling and Advisory Services (OMAS)
 
• Marine Living Resources and Ecology (MLRE)
 
• Ocean Non-Living Resources
 
• Operation and Maintenance of Research Vessels 
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Autonomous/attached institutes of the Ministry that are implementing these sub-schemes:

 
 
• The Indian National Center for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS), Hyderabad
 
• The National Centre for Coastal Research (NCCR), Chennai
 
• The Natio**nal Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR), Goa**
 
• **The Center for Marine Living Resources and Ecology (CMLRE), Kochi**
 
• **T****he National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT), Chennai;** as well as other national institutes.
 
 
 
• Total of **16 sub-projects** are covered under the umbrella programme which addresses various aspects of the development of the ocean, including services, resources, observations, technology, and sciences.
 
• The programme has allowed India to take a leading position in the **Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission (IOC) of UNESCO **for the implemenation** **of the Global Ocean Observing System of the Indian Ocean component.
